subject: Discovery follow-up: security, SOC 2, and subprocessor list (TeleMed Solutions)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@telemedsol.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: security, SOC 2, and subprocessor list (TeleMed Solutions)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and appreciate the transparency on TeleMed's security requirements. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all stay aligned: 

Recap from our call:
- TeleMed is evaluating Redwood to power the new triage assistant in your clinician portal (low-latency inference, PII handling).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II status, HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA), and third-party subprocessors (especially cloud providers and analytics).
- Data flow: PHI will be tokenized client-side and sent to Redwood inference endpoints; TeleMed needs clear boundaries around logs, backups, and any support access.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll send our current subprocessor list and a link to our vendor security questionnaire by EOD (attached — redwood_subprocessors_20270219.pdf).
2) Vivek (copied) will follow up with our SOC 2 timeline and evidence (we're in progress on Type II; expected completion Q2).
3) Dev will coordinate on the BAA template and ring-fence technical controls (KMS, VPC peering options) — please flag any must-have contractual language.
4) If helpful, we can set a short follow-up with your security team next week to walk through the subprocessor list and data boundaries.

Can you confirm: the right security contact is security@telemedsol.com, and is your preferred timeline to have the questionnaire back within 5 business days?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_20270219.pdf (PDF)]

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@telemedsol.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: TeleMed Solutions Security <security@telemedsol.com>
Date: 2027-02-18T11:35:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: security, SOC 2, and subprocessor list (TeleMed Solutions)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A few items from our side: 

- Security contact is correct: security@telemedsol.com (I copied our lead, Priya Shah, on the next email).
- SOC 2: We're prioritizing vendors with SOC 2 Type II or an equivalent attestation. We understand Redwood is in progress; please share expected evidence and any compensating controls you recommend in the interim.
- HIPAA / BAA: TeleMed requires a signed BAA before production. We can share our standard redlines; happy to review Redwood's template.
- Subprocessors: primary cloud provider is AWS (us-east-1). We also need clarity on any analytics or monitoring services that receive logs that may contain metadata.

I'll attach our vendor security questionnaire and the fields we care most about (data residency, access control, logging retention, incident response contact). Can you confirm who will own the questionnaire on Redwood's side?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we are aiming to complete initial vendor evaluations within two weeks.

Best,
Emma Jones
Head of Infra & Security Programs | TeleMed Solutions
emma.jones@telemedsol.com
[Attachment: telemed_vendor_questionnaire.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@telemedsol.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, TeleMed Solutions Security <security@telemedsol.com>
Date: 2027-02-19T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: security, SOC 2, and subprocessor list (TeleMed Solutions)

Hi Emma / Priya —

Thanks — looping in our security and legal leads (Vivek and Dev) to own the questionnaire and BAA respectively. Quick status update: 

- Subprocessor list: attached is our latest export (redwood_subprocessors_20270219.pdf). It includes primary cloud providers (AWS), CDN/edge partners, metrics/observability providers (redacted where relevant for NDA reasons), and our support tools. If you'd like a CSV of name + region + description, we can export that.
- SOC 2: Vivek will share summary evidence and our SOC 2 Type II target date; in the meantime we can provide our SOC 2 Type I report and an interim controls matrix if that helps.
- BAA: Dev will send our standard BAA and highlight editable clauses.
- Questionnaire: I initiated the secure questionnaire link in our system; you should receive an email from "no-reply@redwood.app" with a pre-filled document (please let us know if the link lands in spam). We typically ask for answers within five business days, but we can extend if your team needs more time.

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute sync with your security team + our security ops (Vivek + Dev) on Thursday 2027-02-25 at 10:00 AM PT. Does that work for Priya?

Thanks again — we're committed to making the compliance review as lightweight as possible.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_telemed.docx (DOCX)]
